en: Colossians 3

p.src: 1  If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

en: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
u.src: 1  If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

p.src: 2  Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

en: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
u.src: 2  Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

p.src: 3  For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

en: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
u.src: 3  For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

p.src: 4  When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

en: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
u.src: 4  When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

p.src: 5  Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

en: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
u.src: 5  Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

p.src: 6  For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

en: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
u.src: 6  For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

p.src: 7  You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

en: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,
u.src: 7  You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

p.src: 8  but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

en: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
u.src: 8  but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

p.src: 9  Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

en: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
u.src: 9  Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

p.src: 10  and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

en: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
u.src: 10  and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

p.src: 11  where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

en: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
u.src: 11  where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

p.src: 12  Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

en: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
u.src: 12  Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

p.src: 13  bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

en: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
u.src: 13  bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

p.src: 14  Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

en: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
u.src: 14  Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

p.src: 15  And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

en: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
u.src: 15  And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

p.src: 16  Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
u.src: 16  Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

p.src: 17  Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

en: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
u.src: 17  Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

p.src: 18  Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

en: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
u.src: 18  Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

p.src: 19  Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

en: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
u.src: 19  Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

p.src: 20  Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

en: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
u.src: 20  Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

p.src: 21  Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

en: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
u.src: 21  Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

p.src: 22  Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

en: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
u.src: 22  Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

p.src: 23  And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

en: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
u.src: 23  And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

p.src: 24  knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

en: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
u.src: 24  knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

p.src: 25  But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

en: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
u.src: 25  But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
